findings: Lifecycle is the sole actual observer/sample-clock owner. It rejects paused/out-of-tree/invalid/nonfinite/nonpositive delta before calling motion advance; same-epoch visual refresh0 never calls observer advance, and draw only resynchronizes a changed epoch. Offscreen culling is inside pure drawing, after actual state observation.

World displacement drives stride/travel; normalized acceleration drives bounded start/stop lean. Body_follow and appendage_follow are sequential low-pass states; appendage_follow carries the intermediate body-follow delay into ground head motion. The body mass itself uses drive/travel/phase-weighted joints, so body_follow is not falsely treated as a second independent body clock.

Ground body respiration/load response is spatially masked above anchored feet. Patrol has opposed support/swing phases, chest weight transfer, head-first turn and short knee/head hurt response. Charger carries front compression/horn/shell load, delayed head and shell shock. Hopper uses grounded/air masks, large hind-chain motion, belly breathing/contraction and delayed head rather than a universal image translation.

Diver legacy andUnderworld use their actual source-relative joints. All four live/remains host bob reads now use the same diver=0 helper, avoiding duplicate whole-image float. Wing/rotor phase carries thorax and delayed abdomen/feet; attack load/fold/recovery remain read-only state inputs. Fan wings carry the copper body and later feet through separate phase offsets; asymmetric death uses corpse age until contact and returns before any live clock at progress1.

Sentry sac/nozzle/chamber/leaves respond separately with carried leaf hinges; root bell transports elbow, hanger and leaf attachment through two stem bends before local delayed movement. Planted feet/root masks stay nearly fixed; attack and hurt cues use the existing accepted phase/sample values, not new rays/HP/path helpers.

Six articulated bodies keep the captured drive/hurt/turn/air pose at death0, then blend to anatomical targets independent of live clocks at death1. Patrol final chest/head descent includes the visible-grounding repair; existing opaque head sample reaches-.216192wu from support within1wu. Diver continues its separate authoredD1-D4 owner; exact live deformed vertex-to-D1 equality is not asserted.

Corpse progression/contact is separately epoch/event-gated, stage-owned and paused. Accepted death captures once; persistent charger anddiver keep stable support-local final poses, missing support falls without a new death receipt, transient types hold/fade after settling. Final shaders contain no autonomous TIME channel. Actor death still cancels attacks/stops Motor/removes collision; the reviewed Actor diff only changes its audio dispatch, and Motor/definitions/attack behavior sources remain unchanged.
nonblocking_contract_boundaries: Direct internal PlainsMotion02.advance(actor,0) rebases private _last_position before returning; this ordering pre-existed2ac. Actual production lifecycle rejects zero/nonfinite/paused advancement first, and refresh0 does not call it, so no current production regression was found. The existing zero-tick native assertion checks clocks/inertia values, not every private baseline; do not broaden that claim or bypass the lifecycle in future consumers.

Diver terminal rendering bypasses live deformation and uses its authored death frames. The existing native diver tests prove finite nonrigid live anatomy/no host bob/static terminal bypass, not an exact vertex-continuous lethal handoff through all eight authored frames. Original video remains the visual review source.

The finite opaque/foot/head probes do not prove every opaque contour contact, no interpenetration for every phase/terrain, or perception at normal play size. Body-follow phase, UV masks and floor clamp remain source-level design, with actual visual/player judgement separate.
